name: Bulgaria — Bulgarian parties
intro: compare it with Bulgarian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Bulgaria: those represented in the parliament (Narodno sabranie) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Narodno sabranie) after the 2024 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 240 members. A more recent election is not yet reflected in these seats; the party list includes parties that are strong in current polls.

BSP.name: BSP – United Left
BSP.priorities: Pensions and the elderly, Cost of living, Public services
BSP.description: Successor to the Communist Party; socially conservative for a European socialist party and historically friendly towards Russia.

PP–DB.name: We Continue the Change – Democratic Bulgaria
PP–DB.priorities: Fighting corruption, Rule of law, Deeper European integration, Defence and support for Ukraine
PP–DB.description: Pro-European reformist alliance focused on judicial reform and fighting corruption, strongly pro-Ukraine.

Volt.name: Volt Bulgaria
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

DPS–NN.name: DPS – New Beginning
DPS–NN.priorities: Rights of the national minority, Security and law and order
DPS–NN.description: Wing of the Movement for Rights and Freedoms, the party of Bulgaria's Turkish minority, led by Delyan Peevski, who is under US and UK sanctions for corruption.

GERB.name: GERB–SDS
GERB.priorities: Competitiveness and growth, Security and law and order, Deeper European integration
GERB.description: Centre-right party of former prime minister Boyko Borisov and the largest party in most elections since 2009.

ITN.name: There Is Such a People
ITN.description: Populist party founded by the TV presenter and singer Slavi Trifonov, campaigning against the political establishment.

MECh.name: Morality, Unity, Honour
MECh.priorities: Fighting corruption, Justice reform, Security and law and order
MECh.description: Anti-corruption party that first entered parliament in 2024.

Vazrazhdane.name: Vazrazhdane (Revival)
Vazrazhdane.priorities: National sovereignty, Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries, National identity
Vazrazhdane.description: Pro-Russian nationalist party opposed to the euro, NATO and support for Ukraine.
